statement: Existing measurement, park-detection, park-analysis and live-map foundation files are immutable. New behavior must be introduced as additive modules/adapters without replacing or wrapping away the existing baseline.

authorized_modularizations.scope: Relocate request query and closed-table source assertions to their actual modules and assert service delegation; preserve behavioral expectations.
Relocate compact user identity cell assertion to admin-user-table.js and add service delegation; preserve all layout expectations.

User-authorized modularization of the locked offline measurement service into five additive client-ID, reconciliation, IndexedDB, queue-store, and sync-badge modules. Preserve owner/session gates, Supabase access, photo upload order, persistence behavior, and locked regression tests.

User-authorized modularization of locked live-map presentation into five coordinate, waypoint-selection, measurement-popup, chunked-marker, and waypoint-list modules. Preserve marker idempotency and cancellation tokens, coordinate validity, popup content, waypoint order/filter/paging, and all GPS/data-write gates.

User-authorized second five-module navigation split from locked live-map service: waypoint selection, map viewport, field guidance, waypoint markers, and GPS navigation overlay. Preserve input updates, redraw order, viewport behavior, GPS thresholds, route visualization, and database-write boundaries.

User-authorized five-module split of the locked park geofence service: boundary distance, pure park decision, fresh GPS adapter, audit stamp, and verification use case. Preserve all accuracy/margin/freshness thresholds, legacy circle fallback, no-sensor soft pass, permission/timeout blocking, user messages, server enforcement, and locked regression tests.

User-authorized five-module split of the locked park-query service: shared in-flight coverage request, boundary-scoped cache reset/snapshot, OSM element collection, park-boundary filtering, and water-layer renderer. Preserve same-boundary request identity, stale-response rejection, padded extents, geometry collection/filtering, and legacy wrappers.

User-authorized five-module split of the locked Overpass client: normalized cache key, pending-query coalescing, healthy mirror ordering, request budgets, and mirror health/quarantine updates. Preserve all cache, retry, timeout, quarantine, error, and response contracts.

User-authorized five-module split of locked land-cover geometry services: bounds, UTM projection, rectangular clipping, convex clipping, and projected area/intersection. Preserve all coordinate ordering, equations, clipping tolerances, area results, legacy wrappers, and regression tests; register the modules in the lazy-load chain and offline cache.

User-authorized five-module split of locked lc-validate service: deterministic sampling, area-adjusted accuracy metrics, spectral rules, agreement/gate, and campaign serialization/adjudication. Preserve sampling determinism, scientific thresholds and calculations, campaign formats, IndexedDB persistence, locked regression tests, and validation outputs.

User-authorized five-module split of locked Sentinel-2 lc-s2 service: scene selection/search, temporal windows, per-asset raster grid, spectral evidence, and profile assembly. Preserve GET/CORS behavior, scene coverage, acquisition-date deduplication, per-asset UTM projection, PB04 radiometry, compositing, confirmed seasonal extrema, output metadata, and locked regression tests.
